host: European Innovation Council (EIC) under Horizon Europe
summary: EIC STEP Scale Up provides equity-only investments from EUR 10 million to EUR 30 million to promising start-ups, SMEs, spin-offs, and small mid-caps for scaling high-risk innovations that cannot be fully financed by other investors. It aims to support innovation scale-up in critical areas, with investments tailored individually according to the EIC Fund Investment Guidelines. No grant component is offered under this call.
reporting_requirements: Due diligence and investment agreement aligned with EIC Fund Investment Guidelines
Safeguard measures to protect European interests where necessary
Periodic reporting according to invested amount and project progress
